options.content:
### GossipSub testbed: one run

**Peers**: 6 on one topic, `go-0..2` (go-libp2p) and `js-0..2` (js-libp2p), 2 per kind worker. Mesh D = 3.
**Workload**: publishers `go-1` and `js-1`, 10 msg/s each (Phase 3 default: 1 KiB). Pick the run in **run_id**; set the time range to cover it.
**Isolated in Phase 3**: `go-2` and `js-2` (dashed lines); the window shows as a red annotation.

**What to look for**: completeness 100 % for every subscriber; latency a few ms; connected peers 5 everywhere; no throttling, no restarts; `up` 1 for all peers.
Rows 8–10 are from the logs (VictoriaLogs); the rest from Prometheus. Colours: Go blue, JS orange.

panels.title: Publish rate, last 30 s
panels.description: Successful publishes per second of the run, all publishers. Expected: 20 (2 × 10) during a run, 0 after it.

panels.title: Completeness, worst pair
panels.description: Lowest received ÷ published over all subscriber–publisher pairs, totals of the run. Expected: 100 % once the run has ended (during it, the messages in flight make it 1–2 % lower).

targets.expr: min(sum by (pod, publisher) (gs_messages_received_total{run_id="$run_id", pod=~"$peer", impl=~"$impl"}) / on (publisher) group_left sum by (publisher) (label_replace(gs_publish_success_total{run_id="$run_id"}, "publisher", "$1", "pod", "(.*)")))

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile of the delivery latency over the time range, all receivers of the run (from the histogram buckets). Expected: a few ms.

panels.title: Connected peers, min
panels.description: Lowest number of connected peers over the peers. Expected: 5 (all others).

panels.title: Alert DeliveryCompletenessLow
panels.description: Number of subscribers for which the alert fires. Expected: 0 in a baseline; go-2 and js-2 during an isolation.

panels.title: Publish attempts, successes and errors per second
panels.description: Per publisher, for the run. Expected: attempts = successes = 10 msg/s per publisher; errors 0.

panels.title: Publish errors by reason
panels.description: Failed publishes per second, by reason (encode, publish). Expected: none.

panels.title: Completeness per subscriber, 30 s window
panels.description: Received from each publisher ÷ published by it, rates over 30 s: the alert's expression. Expected: 100 % while a run is steady; short spikes in the first and last 25 s of a run (the peers are scraped up to 5 s apart); 0 for an isolated peer, back about 30 s after recovery.

targets.expr: sum by (pod, publisher) (rate(gs_messages_received_total{run_id="$run_id", pod=~"$peer", impl=~"$impl"}[30s])) / on (publisher) group_left sum by (publisher) (label_replace(rate(gs_publish_success_total{run_id="$run_id"}[30s]), "publisher", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Completeness of the run
panels.description: Totals of the run: rows = subscribers, columns = publishers. Expected: 100 % in each cell once the run has ended (during it, the messages in flight make it 1–2 % off). Messages lost during an isolation stay lost.

targets.expr: sum by (pod, publisher) (gs_messages_received_total{run_id="$run_id", pod=~"$peer", impl=~"$impl"}) / on (publisher) group_left sum by (publisher) (label_replace(gs_publish_success_total{run_id="$run_id"}, "publisher", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Duplicates per second
panels.description: Copies of a message that a peer had already received (redundant forwarding of the mesh). Expected: steady; the JS peers count more.

panels.title: Rejected messages per second, by reason
panels.description: Messages that validation rejected or that could not be delivered. Expected: only self originated message (Go peers see their own messages come back).

panels.title: Delivery latency p50, p95, p99
panels.description: All receivers of the run, over 30 s. Latency = receive time − the publisher's timestamp (one clock: the kind nodes share the Docker VM's). Expected: low and stable.

query.expr: run_id:"$run_id" event:received peer:~"${peer:regex}" impl:~"${impl:regex}" | sort by (latency_us desc) | limit 20

panels.title: p95 latency, Go vs JS receivers
panels.description: 95th percentile over 30 s, by the implementation of the receiver. Expected: close to each other.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, impl) (rate(gs_delivery_latency_seconds_bucket{run_id="$run_id", pod=~"$peer", impl=~"$impl"}[30s])))

query.expr: run_id:"$run_id" event:received peer:~"${peer:regex}" impl:~"${impl:regex}" | sort by (latency_us desc) | limit 20

panels.title: Latency distribution
panels.description: Deliveries per latency bucket (0.5 ms to 5 s) over 30 s. Expected: one band at a few ms.

panels.title: Direct deliveries
panels.description: Share of the first copies that came straight from the publisher (source = publisher), per receiver, from the logs. The rest came through another peer. Depends on the mesh.

targets.expr: run_id:"$run_id" event:received peer:~"${peer:regex}" impl:~"${impl:regex}" | stats by (peer) count() if (source:eq_field(publisher)) direct, count() total | math round(direct / total * 100) as direct_pct | fields peer, direct_pct

panels.title: IHAVE and IWANT received per second
panels.description: Gossip control messages: IHAVE announces message IDs, IWANT asks for missing ones. Expected: IWANT low (the mesh delivers almost all).

panels.title: Connected peers
panels.description: Peers that each peer has a connection to. Expected: 5 (all others); 1 for an isolated peer (its partner).

panels.title: Topic peers
panels.description: Peers that each peer knows as subscribed to the topic. Expected: 5.

panels.title: Mesh peers
panels.description: Peers in the GossipSub mesh of each peer (D = 3, Dlo = 3, Dhi = 4). Expected: 3–4.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU used by each peer container, in cores (limits: Go 0.5, JS 1). Expected: low.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working set of each peer container (limits: Go 128 MiB, JS 256 MiB). Expected: flat.

panels.title: CPU throttling
panels.description: Share of the CPU periods in which the container hit its CPU limit. Expected: about 0.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace="dst", container="peer", pod=~"$peer"}[1m])) / sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace="dst", container="peer", pod=~"$peer"}[1m]))

panels.title: Restarts in the time range
panels.description: Container restarts per peer over the time range (kube-state-metrics). Expected: 0. A deleted and recreated pod is not a restart.

panels.title: Scrape health (up)
panels.description: Whether Prometheus could scrape /metrics of each peer. Expected: 1 (up) for all peers, also for an isolated peer.

panels.title: Time since the last sample
panels.description: Age of the newest sample of each peer. Expected: below 10 s (scrape every 5 s); grows if the scrapes stop.

panels.title: Log lines per second
panels.description: Lines per peer in VictoriaLogs. Expected: steady during a run, never 0 (also during an isolation: the collector reads the files on the node).

targets.expr: kubernetes.pod_namespace:dst peer:~"${peer:regex}" impl:~"${impl:regex}" | stats by (peer) rate() lines

panels.title: isolation_check results
panels.description: Connection checks from go-2 during an isolation (Phase 3): to go-0 must fail, to js-2 must succeed. Empty in a baseline.

targets.expr: event:isolation_check | sort by (_time) | copy _time as at | fields at, peer, to, result

panels.title: Connection events
panels.description: peer_connected and peer_disconnected with their times, as peer: event remote. Expected: none in a baseline; during an isolation, the disconnects and, after it, the reconnects.

panels.title: Missed messages
panels.description: Per subscriber and publisher: published − received in the run, from the logs. Expected: 0 in a baseline; about rate × isolation length for go-2 and js-2. A subscriber that received nothing from a publisher has no row.

targets.expr: run_id:"$run_id" event:received peer:~"${peer:regex}" impl:~"${impl:regex}" | stats by (peer, publisher) count() received | join by (publisher) (run_id:"$run_id" event:published | stats by (peer) count() published | rename peer as publisher) | math published - received as missed | sort by (missed desc, peer, publisher) | fields peer, publisher, published, received, missed

panels.title: Late arrivals (latency over 1 s)
panels.description: Messages that arrived more than 1 s after they were published, for example through gossip after a reconnect. Expected: none in a baseline.

targets.expr: run_id:"$run_id" event:received latency_us:>1000000 peer:~"${peer:regex}" impl:~"${impl:regex}" | format "<peer> ← <publisher> seq <seq>: <latency_us> µs via <source>" as _msg

panels.title: Receipt timeline of message $seq
panels.description: Each peer that received message $seq of the run, in the order of receipt, per publisher. Latency = receive time − the publisher's timestamp. Source = the peer it came from (= the publisher: direct).

targets.expr: run_id:"$run_id" event:received seq:$seq | math latency_us / 1000 as latency_ms | sort by (publisher, _time) | copy _time as at | fields at, publisher, peer, latency_ms, source
